name: josie trinh
role: product marketer for the people on the other side of the launch.
intro: i think the best launches feel less like announcements and more like invitations. whether it's marvel contest of champions players, shopify merchants, or a room of 800+ student hackers, i care about who's on the other end, and what makes them want to show up and stick around.
lately that's meant live-game marketing at kabam games, go-to-market and customer stories at teifi digital, and helping grow sfu surge's stormhacks into western canada's largest hackathon.
steve jobs said stay hungry, stay foolish. i'd rather stay hungry, stay chalant: curious enough to keep learning, and caring enough to bring people along with me.
description: josie trinh is a product marketer who builds launches around community and connection, across games, commerce, and student hackathons.

work.focus: live-game marketing, campaign coordination, and creative briefing
work.summary: live-game marketing for marvel contest of champions: monthly campaign plans, creative briefs, and app-store event cards that helped drive 700,000+ installs in three weeks.

work.focus: ecommerce go-to-market, lead gen, and customer storytelling for shopify merchants
work.summary: go-to-market for workmate's shopify pos launch to bike shops. the campaign brought in 100+ MQLs, half of which became PQLs.

work.focus: hackathon growth, integrated marketing, and hacker experience
work.summary: helped make stormhacks western canada's largest hackathon two years running: 2,500+ applications across both editions and 93.5% submission retention in 2026.

bio.text: i’m a product marketer who places real, raw human interactions at my core, and values user-first communications
